payload.title: Migrated owners can't retrieve their random fencing token to fence pushes
payload.body: Now that migrated claims use a random claim_id (claim-migrated-<uuid>), the migrated owner never sees it — the migration created the claim, not 'tasks claim' (which is what prints the token). So once TASKS_CLAIM_ENFORCE is armed, a migrated owner cannot put the right Task-Claim trailer on their commit and check-push blocks their own legit push. This makes expose-claimid-and-assignee-in-list-json a PREREQUISITE for arming enforcement on a migrated repo (the owner must be able to look up their own token). Options: (a) implement token retrieval (expose-claimid...) and document it in the arm-hard-claim-enforcement checklist, and/or (b) let 'tasks claim <id>' by the current owner re-print the existing token without stealing. Surfaced fixing the guessable-token security bug.
